FN-DGY7KNH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 528
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Frances Holk-Jones
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 528 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General and district attorneys to investigate claims of imposition of unconscionable prices,
which could be offset by civil fines imposed, if found in violation of the provisions of this bill.
